purpose: PF-BETA-10 Exotic-first prototype overlay. Ownership candidates only; gameplay claims require explicit Bungie or manifest evidence.

anchorEvidence.buildFocus: Fusion Grenade cycling: Starfire Protocol adds a Fusion Grenade charge, empowered weapon damage recharges Fusion Grenades, and Fusion Grenade defeats grant Rift energy.

synergyChains.evidence: Bungie current Starfire Protocol DestinyInventoryItemDefinition describes Fusion Harness: Fusion Grenades have an additional charge and recharge from empowered weapon damage, with empowered weapon final blows granting more energy. Defeating targets with Fusion Grenades grant Rift energy.

Bungie current Starfire Protocol Fusion Harness states that defeating targets with Fusion Grenades grants Rift energy. Bungie Solar 3.0 documentation classifies Fusion Grenade as a Solar grenade; Destiny manifest API ID 1013086087 resolves Fusion Grenade as a Solar Grenade.

vaultPool.name: Pleiades Corrector

ownedRoll.name: Demolitionist
ownedRoll.description: Kills with this weapon generate grenade energy. Activating your grenade ability reloads this weapon from reserves.

vaultPool.evidence: Bungie DestinyInventoryItemDefinition/3556999246 lists Pleiades Corrector as a Solar Legendary Scout Rifle with Demolitionist and the stated grenade-energy description.

vaultPool.name: The Summoner

ownedRoll.name: Golden Tricorn
ownedRoll.description: Final blows with this weapon grant bonus damage. While this buff is active, grenade or melee kills of the same damage type greatly increase its damage and duration.

vaultPool.evidence: Bungie DestinyInventoryItemDefinition/1820994983 lists The Summoner as a Solar Legendary Auto Rifle with Golden Tricorn and the stated matching-damage grenade/melee trigger.

vaultPool.name: Le Monarque

ownedRoll.name: Poison Arrows
ownedRoll.description: Arrows fired while perfectly drawn become poison arrows. Precision hits with poison arrows stun the combatant and spread poison to nearby ones.

vaultPool.evidence: Existing additive Bungie evidence identifies Le Monarque and Poison Arrows; its supplied perk evidence has no Fusion Grenade, grenade-energy, empowered-weapon, or Rift producer/consumer relationship.

vaultPool.name: Gnawing Hunger

ownedRoll.name: Tap the Trigger
ownedRoll.description: Grants a short period of increased stability and accuracy on initial trigger pull.

ownedRoll.name: Rampage
ownedRoll.description: Kills with this weapon temporarily grant increased damage. Stacks 3x.

vaultPool.evidence: Existing additive Bungie evidence identifies this Gnawing Hunger roll with Tap the Trigger and Rampage; neither supplied perk participates in the Starfire Fusion Grenade loop.

vaultPool.name: Sunbracers

intrinsic.name: Helium Spirals
intrinsic.description: Increases the duration of Solar Grenades. Solar melee kills grant unlimited Solar Grenade energy for a brief time.

vaultPool.evidence: Bungie DestinyInventoryItemDefinition/1862800747 lists Sunbracers and Helium Spirals. It is genuine Solar grenade armor but cannot be equipped with the anchor Exotic Starfire Protocol.

vaultPool.name: Phoenix Protocol
